spec.title: gitlab-sync fleet
spec.description: Every gitlab-sync tenant (Kubernetes cluster, namespace and job) at a glance. Tenants need the k8s.cluster.name and k8s.namespace.name resource attributes promoted to Prometheus labels.

links.title: Tenant details
links.tooltip: The gitlab-sync dashboard, one tenant at a time

spec.name: datasource
spec.label: Data source
spec.description: Prometheus receiving the gitlab-sync OTLP metrics.

spec.name: cluster
spec.label: Cluster
spec.description: k8s.cluster.name resource attribute.

spec.name: namespace
spec.label: Namespace
spec.description: k8s.namespace.name resource attribute.

spec.name: job
spec.label: Job
spec.description: service.name, when a namespace runs several gitlab-sync jobs.

spec.name: window
spec.label: Run window
spec.description: Time bucket of the graphs. Each bucket shows the last (or largest) run of each tenant in it.

spec.name: stale
spec.label: Stale after
spec.description: A tenant with no run for longer than this is counted as stale.

spec.title: Tenants
spec.description: Tenants (cluster, namespace, job) that ran at least once in the time range.

spec.expr: count(last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Healthy
spec.description: Tenants whose last run exited with 0.

spec.expr: count(last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m]) == 0) or vector(0)

spec.title: Warnings
spec.description: Tenants whose last run had non-blocking errors only.

spec.expr: count(last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m]) == 2) or vector(0)

spec.title: Failing
spec.description: Tenants whose last run had blocking errors.

spec.expr: count(last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m]) == 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: Stale
spec.description: Tenants with no run for longer than the Stale after variable: the CronJob may be suspended or broken.

spec.expr: count((time() - max_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (timestamp(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m])) > $stale) or vector(0)

spec.title: Runs
spec.description: Runs of every tenant in the time range.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Success rate
spec.description: Share of all runs that exited with 0.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"} == 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum(count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range:1m]))

spec.title: Projects mirrored
spec.description: Projects mirrored successfully by the last run of every tenant.

spec.expr: sum(last_over_time((sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", entity="project", outcome="success"}) or on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) 0 * max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m]))

spec.title: Tenants
spec.description: One line per tenant, failing first, then stale, then with warnings. Click a namespace to open its gitlab-sync dashboard.

spec.expr: last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m])

time() - max_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (timestamp(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m])
last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m])
sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))

sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"} == 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range:1m]))

last_over_time((sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", entity="project", outcome="success"}) or on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) 0 * max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m])

last_over_time((sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", entity="project", outcome="failure"}) or on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) 0 * max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m])

last_over_time((sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_errors_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", severity="blocking"}) or on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) 0 * max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m])

(sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", status_class=~"5xx|error"}[$__range])) or on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) 0 * sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))) / sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job, le) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range])))

(sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", status="429"}[$__range])) or on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) 0 * sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))) / sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (increase(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range]))

((last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m])) == bool 1) * 3 + ((last_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"})[$__range:1m])) == bool 2) + ((time() - max_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (timestamp(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m])) > bool $stale) * 2

max_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job, service_version) (timestamp(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m]) == on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) group_left () max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (max_over_time(max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job, service_version) (timestamp(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}))[$__range:1m]))

spec.title: Run status by tenant
spec.description: Last run of each tenant in every Run window: OK, Warnings (exit 2) or Failed (exit 1). Gaps are windows without a run.

spec.expr: max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__interval]))
max by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (last_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_duration_seconds{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Success rate by tenant
spec.description: Share of each tenant's runs that exited with 0, over the time range.

spec.expr: sort(sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (count_over_time((gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"} == 0)[$__range:1m])) / sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (count_over_time(gitlab_sync_run_status{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__range:1m])))

spec.title: Projects mirrored per run
spec.description: Largest run of each tenant in every Run window.

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_entities_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", entity="project", outcome="success"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Blocking errors per run
spec.description: Blocking errors make the run exit with 1. Use the logs of the tenant to find out which project failed.

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_errors_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", severity="blocking"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: API error ratio by tenant
spec.description: Share of the GitLab API requests answered 5xx or without a response.

spec.expr: (sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", status_class=~"5xx|error"}[$__interval])) or on (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) 0 * sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__interval]))) / sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Rate-limited requests per run
spec.description: GitLab API requests answered 429 Too Many Requests: the tenant hits its GitLab's rate limits.

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_requests_total{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", status="429"}[$__interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (k8s_cluster_name, k8s_namespace_name, job, le) (max_over_time(gitlab_sync_api_duration_seconds_bucket{k8s_cluster_name=~"$cluster", k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__interval])))
